deadline_notes.en: Nottingham's official standard-deadline table provides exact 2026/27 dates, replacing the previous vague six-to-seven-week wording. No 2027/28 deadline was published on the checked page.

verification_notes.en: The taught-course application guide makes the degree certificate (if completed) and final/current transcript necessary for assessment. Two references and a personal statement are course-dependent, so they are not marked universally required for this Mechanical Engineering MSc record.
